title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I'm a Muslimah, it was and is my desire to serve Allah. A year back i joined university where I met a Shia Muslim classmate from Iran who had very twisted ideas about Islam but he tried and is still trying to search for the truth. my intuition told me that Allah had sent me here as a medium for him to attain hidayah, since my purpose of joining the course was solely to become capable of serving Islam. Alhamdolillah, I'd been able to clear many of his doubts concerning Islam. It's obvious that how much he now respected me for my help to him and one day he expressed his desire to marry me and wanted to meet my parents but i told him about his Shia background and i'm trying to convince him that Sunni way is better and more appropriate. Listening to this he agreed to change his Madhab too. I too solely for the purpose of being his guide for his whole life, want to get married to him. But I come from a very conservative family and i hope you can understand how difficult it is for a girl in such environment express her desire to get married according to her choice. Also another problem is our nationality, He's from Iran and i'm an Indian. He doesn't have any job right now which is also a hindrance in the way for us to marry as my parents would surely prefer a person who's well settled in life. As a good Muslimah how should i deal with this situation? I really want to convince my parents that i wish to marry him but because of their conservative ideas they may regard the presentation of my wish to be very shameful and disrespectful. How can i present my wish in accordance with Islamic principles to them? I Performed Istikhara and visioned pleasant red colour and lovely flames. Though i didn't understand the meaning of this dream i felt extremely happy throughout the next day. Does this imply good? Please help me to interpret the dream in the best way possible. Please i hope to receive guidance from you. Lastly, I sincerely ask for your dua for both of us, especially for his hidayah. 4065 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 45986 Country: India Title: Status Of My Nikah Question: I am married to a sunni Muslim girl since 2 years and after marriage I discovered that in her house she had bandish in the corners of wall across the house. I later removed all those and found that it was not a Quranic verse but Sehar related things. I questioned her and she said that She doesn't know what was inside it and she might have been misguided by a Maulana who apparently was an Amil. She said he cheated her of money and he had such an influence on her that he would charge her money every now and then and that she no longer is interacting with him. I explained her about tauheed and shirk related matters. I destroyed most of them and asked her to dispose off the remaining in her possession. After 2 years I found some material or papers that had Sehar related kufri things written on them. She says she does not know or remember anything. I want to know is the nikah valid or not with such kind of a person. She offers salah, reads Quran and observes other things. Answer ID: 45986 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1019/799/B=1434) The Maulana who misguided her and kept her in darkness he shall be sinful. No impact shall take place on the nikah and iman of the girl, as she does not know anything about it. Both of you should live as husband and wife and should not have any doubt. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
